steps: Sign in to developer.ebay.com (join the free Developers Program if asked)
Open 'Application Keys' and create a keyset under Production (not Sandbox)
If asked about Marketplace Account Deletion notifications, choose the exemption 'I do not persist eBay data' (or give your endpoint) - the keys stay off until this is done
You need the Production 'App ID (Client ID)' and 'Cert ID (Client Secret)'
